english.notes:
Section 22(7) provides that a constable or authorised officer is entitled to remove and retain the plate or disc from a vehicle to which an expired, suspended or revoked London private hire vehicle licence relates following:-
(a) a failure to comply with subsection (2) or a direction under subsection (4);
(b) a suspension or revocation of the licence which has immediate effect by virtue of section 9(3) or 17(2).

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

In the case of a continuing offence, to a fine not exceeding ten pounds for each day during which an offence continues after conviction.
